La masse la plus lourde descend et l’aut: The heavier mass falls and the other rises. With equal masses, the system released from rest stays still. Pulley inertia reduces acceleration and makes the tensions different.
La force d’équilibre compense le poids d: The equilibrium force balances the weight of the moving assembly. Above it, the load rises; below it, it falls. With massive pulleys, some work also goes into rotation.

Aucun travail extérieur de traction : la: No external pulling work: the decrease in potential energy becomes translational and rotational kinetic energy.
Le travail fourni est égal à la variatio: Supplied work equals the increase in potential energy plus kinetic energy, including rotation. Negative work means the pulling force receives energy.
Les vitesses verticales sont opposées ;: Vertical velocities are opposite; positive is upwards for each mass.
La vitesse de traction est n fois celle: Pulling speed is n times the load speed. A negative value means the load descends and the rope returns.
Les forces sont constantes dans cet essa: Forces are constant in this trial: accelerations stay constant until the simulation limit.
